title: Rangeland soil-carbon lane (SoilGrids SOC / OCD)
note: SOC does not vary by day, so this is a static_lookup lane keyed to a SOURCE WATERMARK per foundation/parquet/lane_contract.py -- writing it 365 times a year is the failure mode to avoid (RUNBOOK 0.41.7). Rasters are already published and catalogued in geo.published_raster; geo.soil_survey carries NO carbon field, SoilGrids is the only carbon source in the estate. Unblocked 2026-08-24 by owner approval of rasterio, pinned in pyproject and installed with `uv pip install`, deliberately NOT `uv sync`. NOTE: RUNBOOK 0.41.4 found NO carbon-targeting signal in the fire index -- this lane must not be justified as fire targeting.

slices.task: Sample SoilGrids COGs at cell centroids and emit a static_lookup lane
Raster sampling helper -- windowed reads against the COG, never a full-array load

shared_writes.reason: single module that knows every lane; s1 serialises the registration

tripwires: SOC is static -- a daily_series nature here writes the same values 365x/year and inflates the store for nothing
published_raster.scale_divisor is 10 for BOTH soc and ocd; raw band values must be divided or every figure is 10x wrong
COGs must be read windowed; a full-array load of a 16 MB compressed raster is exactly the class of local blow-up RUNBOOK 0.41.6 records
